name: calymob-tooling
description: Node tooling for CalyMob: Firestore rules tests, migrations and release scripts. The mobile app is Flutter (pubspec.yaml); Cloud Functions live in functions/.

scripts.test:rules:boutique-access: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --project calymob-boutique-access-rules --only firestore "node scripts/test-boutique-access-rules.cjs"
scripts.test:rules:event-registration: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --project calymob-event-registration-rules --only firestore "node scripts/test-event-registration-rules.cjs"
scripts.test:rules:read-state: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --project calymob-read-state-rules --only firestore "node scripts/test-read-state-rules.cjs"
scripts.test:rules:pool-formation: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --project calymob-pool-formation-rules --only firestore "node scripts/test-pool-formation-remarks-rules.cjs"
scripts.test:migration:read-state: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --project demo-calymob-migration --only firestore "node scripts/test-migrate-unread-read-state.cjs"
scripts.test:rules:evaluation: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --project calymob-com084-evaluation-rules --only firestore "node scripts/test-evaluation-rules.cjs"
scripts.test:rules:bug-report-storage: JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test-bug-report-storage.json --project calymob-bug-report-storage-rules --only firestore,storage "node scripts/test-bug-report-storage-rules.cjs"
